# Cedric Stanhope

## Overview

- **Age:** Thirteen years old by Volume 5  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P61](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0061), [v2 c1 P48](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0048), [v2 c15 P4](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0004), [v2 c15 P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011), [v4 c3 P31](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0031)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c3 P31](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0031)</sub>
- **Origin:** United States  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c1 P48](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0048)</sub>
- **Role:** Student and aspiring poet  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c26 P13](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0013), [v4 c3 P32](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0032)</sub>

## Appearance

Cedric has a small, refined face with delicate features, a full crimson mouth, and dark blue eyes. He has a halo of chestnut curls that his grandmother tries to tame, though he eventually cuts them short as he grows taller. By age thirteen, he is tall for his age, with broad shoulders.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 c17 P10](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0010), [v2 c18 P15](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0015), [v2 c26 P13](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0013), [v4 c3 P31](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0031)_

## Personality

Cedric is a thoughtful, imaginative, and sensitive boy who perceives the world with poetic wonder. He is deeply affectionate, courteous, and polite, forming strong bonds with those he considers kindred spirits. Despite his dreamy nature and rich inner fantasy world, he possesses a strong sense of fairness and manliness, refusing to be easily intimidated.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c11 P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 c15 P19](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0019), [v2 c19 P19](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0019)_

## History

Cedric arrives in Brierley from the United States to live with his grandmother Stanhope after his father goes abroad. He enrols in the Brierley school under Nell Harcourt, immediately forming a close bond with her as a kindred spirit. During a cold winter night, when Posy Fay contracts croup, Cedric rushes to summon help and assists in caring for her. He develops a rich fantasy life involving 'rock people' along the shore and shares his imaginative stories with Nell. At age eleven, his father Stephen Stanhope returns to visit him. Cedric meets Miss Rosalind Penrose of Echo Cottage and forms a warm affection for her, unknowingly helping to reunite her with his father. After Stephen and Miss Rosalind marry, Cedric plans to move with them to Boston, though he continues to spend his summers on St. Brendan's Island. As he grows older, he begins writing poetry, earning praise from Nell for his literary promise.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P20](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0020), [v1 c18 P30](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0030), [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c1 P48](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0048), [v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 c5 P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 c18 P22](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0022), [v2 c21 P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 c23 P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027), [v2 c23 P33](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0033), [v2 c26 P13](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0013), [v2 c29 P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v4 c3 P32](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0032)_

## Background by volume

- Born in the United States to Stephen Stanhope and his late wife  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c1 P48](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0048), [v2 c19 P22](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0022)</sub>
- Lost his mother at the age of eight  <sub>[v2 c19 P22](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0022), [v2 c19 P24](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0024)</sub>
- Sent to St. Brendan's Island to live with his grandmother Stanhope  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c1 P48](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0048)</sub>

## Quotes

> I ask you to take these, teacher, which I discovered in the field belonging to Mr. Duckett, and I returned so I could offer them to you since I believed you were a lady who would appreciate them, and also because... teacher, I am fond of you.  <sub>[v2 c5 P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021)</sub>

> When she is sleeping, I love her most, and even more when she is awake.  <sub>[v2 c11 P21](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0021)</sub>

> Mrs. Sowerby, father made a pretty good job of picking out my first mother and I could trust him to pick out just as good a one the second time.  <sub>[v2 c18 P22](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0022)</sub>

> I didn’t become really acquainted with him until my little mother had died. However, once you do come to know him, he is splendid.  <sub>[v2 c19 P22](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0022)</sub>

> You will never age. You belong to those lucky human beings who discovered and imbibed the Fountain of Youth,—you alongside Mother Rosalind.  <sub>[v2 c26 P13](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0013)</sub>
